phase1.instructions: Use only the tools returned by tools/list. Follow the installed phase-one production skills. Read the selected project and current content version before editing. Save native source through motion_edit_project; preview and export perform their required checks internally. Use motion_list_versions to find project snapshots and motion_restore_version to restore one as a new version while retaining later history. A transport cancellation does not prove a background export stopped. Report actual export state and accessible results; technical validation does not replace visual, audio and player review. Never guess a project from another conversation. Read skills locally or with resources/list and resources/read (motion://workflow/production/start, or the selected specialist); engine authoring guidance is motion://engine/SKILL.md and relative Markdown references under motion://engine/. For new work create explicitly; motion_open_preview never silently creates a project. Persisted create/import/edit/restore/export/cancel and review requests require a stable requestId; preview action=open does not. Edits require projectId, expectedRevision and expectedVersionId. Query export progress through motion_get_project with projectId and exportJobId. Project list and version list are five per page; follow nextCursor. For template discovery, call motion_list_templates to obtain a local JSONL index path, then search that file with local tools. It does not return search results. Read the selected ID with motion_get_template; create its independent editable copy with motion_create_project projectType=template.
